description: This file defines schemas and API documentation for managing tags in the Superset project, including classes for tag responses, tagging objects, and bulk operations, as well as OpenAPI method overrides.

classes.name: TagGetResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for tag response containing id, name, and type.

classes.name: TaggedObjectEntityResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for tagged object entity including metadata and relationships.

methods.name: TagPostSchema
methods.description: Schema extending TagObjectSchema for creating tags.

methods.name: TagPutSchema
methods.description: Schema extending TagObjectSchema for updating tags.
